notes.title: Business battler Billion Road will be delisted from Steam soon, and it's 80% off
notes.notes:
Fusing the money-grabbing mayhem of Monopoly with the board-based structure of Mario Party and Fortune Street, Billion Road is a chaotic race to riches against your friends as you aim to become the dominant tycoon in Japan. The bad news is that developer Bandai Namco is preparing to delist Billion Road on Steam, meaning you'll no longer have the chance to buy it. The good news is that you've still got one week to grab it, and it's a whopping 80% off.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Random Match Mode added!
notes.notes:
Billion Road now has a new game feature called Random Match Mode. This is a quick pick up game mode that allows you to play against other players online. Game play term for this mode is one year, so it's perfect for a quick pick up game. (Player search is random)

How to access Random Match Mode:
1. On the main title screen click the right pointing arrow at the right side of the screen.
2. Click the "Random Match Mode" icon.
3. Create or select your character.
4. Game will begin searching for other players.
5. Once other players are found the game will begin.

Note: If there are no other players online on Random Match Mode the game will stay in the load screen to keep searching for other players.
During the match if a player leaves the game he or she will be replaced by a CPU controlled character, so the rest of the players can complete the match.

If you encounter any issues please let us know. Thank you very much!
